changelog: FIX CRITICAL: _sbRestDeleteAll now uses WHERE clause (id=gt.0) — Supabase requires WHERE for DELETE, was returning 400 error before!
FIX CRITICAL: _doRestPoll now ALWAYS updates vales from Supabase even when empty — no more zombie vales after deletion.
FIX CRITICAL: Service Worker no longer auto-sends SKIP_WAITING on updatefound — prevents stuck update/reload loop.
FIX CRITICAL: SW install uses Promise.all instead of allSettled — prevents broken SW with partial cache.
FIX: SW activate now sequences claim() before notifying clients — prevents reload into old SW.
FIX: Catalog shows ALL products (not just stock>0) — stock shown as badge with Agotado state.
FIX: catId mapping for products missing catId but having categoria string — products no longer vanish on category click.
FIX: Product image onerror handler properly shows fallback icon instead of broken image.
FIX: Admin catalog shows all products including out-of-stock for management.
FIX: controllerchange/SW_UPDATED only trigger reload when user initiated update.
